      "text": "**Analyzing Terraria Buffs**\n\nI\u0027m currently observing a Terraria screenshot with the Calamity mod active, focusing on the extensive list of Banner buffs. The tooltip\u0027s details are essential to decipher the mechanics; particularly the \"increased damage and defense\" modifier. The \"Banner\" buff with its long list of effects points to Luiafk\u0027s \"Unlimited Buffs\" feature, where carrying banners provides global buffs. The \"Void Bag\" doesn\u0027t explain the full mechanic.\n\n\n**Confirming Buff Origin**\n\nOkay, I\u0027ve confirmed that the \"Banner\" buff\u0027s extensive list isn\u0027t Calamity\u0027s doing; it\u0027s a QoL mod, and the \"toxic downpour\" confirms Calamity\u0027s presence. Furthermore, the row of icons is definitively the toggle menu of **Fargo\u0027s Soul Mod**. The long list is caused by an interaction between these Fargo\u0027s mods. The \"Rotdog\" and \"Acid Rain\" confirm Calamity presence, but the banners are from Fargo\u0027s.\n\n\n**Explaining Banner Behavior**\n\nI\u0027ve determined the massive tooltip displaying a long list of banners is due to Fargo\u0027s Soul Mod or Mutant Mod interacting with banners in your inventory or storage.       "text": "This is \"normal\" in the sense that your game isn\u0027t broken, but that massive list isn\u0027t a standard feature of Calamity itself. It’s actually a result of using the **Fargo\u0027s Soul Mod** (or Fargo\u0027s Mutant Mod) alongside Calamity.\n\nHere is the breakdown of what\u0027s happening on your screen:\n\n1.  **The Huge List:** The endless list of enemies (Angler Fish, Rotdog, etc.) is caused by **Fargo\u0027s Mod**. It has a Quality of Life feature that grants you the buffs of any Banners you have in your inventory or Piggy Bank without needing to place them. The mod is helpfully (or unhelpfully) listing *every single active banner buff* in that one tooltip.\n    *   *How to fix it:* As the tooltip says, you can go into the **Fargo\u0027s Config** (usually accessible via the \"Soul Toggles\" menu—that rainbow square icon below your hotbar—or the Mod Configuration menu in settings) to hide the \"Infinite Buffs\" text so it doesn\u0027t take up your whole screen.\n\n2.  **\"Rotdog\":** Since you asked about Calamity specifically, **Rotdog** is indeed a Calamity enemy. It spawns during the **Acid Rain** event (which is currently active, indicated by the *\"A toxic downpour falls over the wasteland\"* text).\n    *   *Fun Fact:* The Rotdog used to be called the \"Pitbull\" in older versions of the mod but was renamed/resprited.\n\n3.  **The Event:** The green rain and the text at the bottom confirm you are in the **Acid Rain** event, which is exclusive to the Calamity mod.\n\n**TL;DR:** The enemies and the event are normal **Calamity** content, but the absurdly long text box is **Fargo\u0027s Mod** showing off your banner collection. You can turn the list display off in the Fargo\u0027s config!",

      "parts": [{
        "text": "This is \""
      }, {
        "text": "normal\" in the sense that your game isn\u0027t broken, but that massive list isn\u0027t a standard feature of Cal"
      }, {
        "text": "amity itself. It’s actually a result of using the **Fargo\u0027s Soul Mod** (or Fargo"
      }, {
        "text": "\u0027s Mutant Mod) alongside Calamity.\n\nHere is the breakdown of what\u0027s happening on your screen:\n\n"
      }, {
        "text": "1.  **The Huge List:** The endless list of enemies (Angler Fish, Rotdog, etc.) is caused by"
      }, {
        "text": " **Fargo\u0027s Mod**. It has a Quality of Life feature that grants you the buffs of any Banners you have in"
      }, {
        "text": " your inventory or Piggy Bank without needing to place them. The mod is helpfully (or unhelpfully) listing"
      }, {
        "text": " *every single active banner buff* in that one tooltip.\n    *   *How to fix it:* As the tooltip says"
      }, {
        "text": ", you can go into the **Fargo\u0027s Config** (usually accessible via the \"Soul Toggles\" menu"
      }, {
        "text": "—that rainbow square icon below your hotbar—or the Mod Configuration menu in settings) to hide the \"Infinite Buffs\" text"
      }, {
        "text": " so it doesn\u0027t take up your whole screen.\n\n2.  **\"Rotdog\":** Since you asked about"
      }, {
        "text": " Calamity specifically, **Rotdog** is indeed a Calamity enemy. It spawns during the **Acid Rain**"
      }, {
        "text": " event (which is currently active, indicated by the *\"A toxic downpour falls over the wasteland\"* text).\n    *   *"
      }, {
        "text": "Fun Fact:* The Rotdog used to be called the \"Pitbull\" in older versions of the mod but was renamed/"
      }, {
        "text": "resprited.\n\n3.  **The Event:** The green rain and the text at the bottom confirm you are in"
      }, {
        "text": " the **Acid Rain** event, which is exclusive to the Calamity mod.\n\n**TL;DR:** The"
      }, {
        "text": " enemies and the event are normal **Calamity** content, but the absurdly long text box is **Fargo"
      }, {
        "text": "\u0027s Mod** showing off your banner collection. You can turn the list display off in the Fargo\u0027s config!"
      }, {
        "text": "",
        "thoughtSignature": ""
      }]
    }],
